articles.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
articles.snippet: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin director Justin Mateen buys nearly $2 million of ABTC stock
articles.snippet: Mateen purchased more than 306,000 shares across two days following the company's quarterly earnings, lifting his stake to more than 492,000 shares.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Dormant Since 2011 Moves Millions in BTC
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin address that had stayed silent for 15 years just sent its coins out for the first time.

articles.title: MyTrade Founder Fined $10K Over Bots That Wash Traded 60 Cryptocurrencies
articles.snippet: Liu Zhou told undercover agents the objective was to make other buyers lose money, according to the Justice Department.
